description: Start a web or Drive research job in a notebook (fast or deep). Returns a job handle; poll with research_status, then import with research_import. Queries under 4 words are rejected unless force is true. Mode discover is not yet available (UNSUPPORTED_BY_TRANSPORT).

corpus.description: web (default) or drive; deep supports web only

force.description: allow a query shorter than 4 words

mode.description: fast (default) or deep; discover is not yet available

notebook.description: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

query.description: what to research; at least 4 words unless force is set

name: research_start
